reviews.text: Very professional and excellent service. Paras installed my heat pump and did an outstanding job from start to finish. The work was clean, efficient, and done to a high standard. Pricing was also very reasonable. I would highly recommend him

We had multiple companies out to quote us for a new furnace but Paras’ quote was the most reasonable, for a great quality furnace, with minimal extra charges (some companies like to tack on the extras!) Paras was friendly, reliable, clean and punctual. He answered any questions we had and managed our expectations throughout the process. We will gladly call on him again when the time comes. Thank you, Paras!

Excellent, professional service. Very informative and knowledgeable. Paras handled the furnace and central air in our building and has done a wonderful job keeping us comfortable. Friendly and efficient, definitely recommend.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent HVAC service from Paras!

Paras did a great job installing my heat pump outdoor unit. He was professional, reliable, and very transparent about the work. He provided a proper itemized invoice, explained everything clearly, and made sure the system was tested and running properly before leaving.

It is great to see a new business owner who takes pride in his work and treats customers with respect. I would highly recommend Paras and wish him great success with his business!
Awesome to deal with. Professional service. Always arrives on time, provides great advice and pricing.
